structured_output.summary: The change implements both spec steps of DataView.prototype.getInt8. It takes this as view and returns ? GetViewValue(view, byteOffset, true, Int8). It delegates to the existing shared helper get_view_value, so the ToIndex, bounds and buffer-read steps live there. Errors propagate from the helper, and the argument is read with get_or_undefined(0). The only other edit is renaming new_target to _new_target, which is needed now that the parameter is unused. The gate report shows all 34 target tests passing with no regressions and no not-implemented results. I did not see the helper's source, but the passing tests and the clean build support it.
